newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro launch process irreversible - De Silguy.
newsitem.headline: Euro launch process irreversible - De Silguy.

text.p: The European Union's Economic Affairs Commissioner Yves-Thibault De Silguy said on Wednesday he believed the process to launch a single European currency was irreversible.
Asked in an interview on RTL radio what obstacles lay in the path to European monetary union, De Silguy said, "I think the process is now irreversible".
He reiterated that any delay in the launch of the euro, scheduled for January 1, 1999, would spell its doom.
"A delay in the euro...would mean its death. Clearly it would entail a renegotiation of the Maastricht treaty" laying out the terms for monetary union, he said.

The final choice on the first wave of member nations will be made in late April or early May of 1998 based on 1997 economic data. "From what we know today, a majority of (EU) member states would comply," he said.
